object.attr: stakeholder: agents, prompts and scripts name tools, parameters and fields, so a rename, a removed field or a newly required parameter breaks them. Holds in 0.x too: a break needs a reason recorded in the changelog (decided on 2026-11-10; review Q16). Harmonising parameter names was left out of 0.3.0 for that reason.
object.description: The MCP server should offer each tool, parameter, parameter type, parameter default, result field and `error_type` value that the previous release offered, with each optional parameter still optional.
